thread:
camille: Quick heads-up — I have three linked PRs that need a merge choreography: `redwood-api#2798` (breaking-ish response shape tweak), `redwood-sdk#1421` (client adapts to new shape), and `redwood-console#305` (console rendering + minor e2e adjust). Also a charts patch in `charts/runtime#78` to bump image/tag. Can we coordinate approvals and merge order?
ryan: Ack. How breaking is the API change? can SDK do a fallback? :thinking_face:
camille: Not totally breaking — it's additive + renames one top-level field. SDK currently relies on the old key in a few spots. I added a compat layer behind a feature flag in the SDK PR but we'd like to avoid long-lived flags.
ingrid: Can you link the PRs? I'll check the API one first.
camille: Links: api https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-api/pull/2798, sdk https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-sdk/pull/1421, console https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-console/pull/305, charts https://github.com/redwood-inference/charts/pull/78
pranay: I can review the API today. FYI the dedicated CI job for `api` is green but integration tests with `sdk` mock show 2 failures. snippet from local run:
```
FAIL test_client_response_mapping.py::TestMapping::test_rename_field
E   AssertionError: expected 'model_id' to be present
```
I'll dig but looks small.
sofia: I can do SDK review after pranay signs off. Who's the console owner for approval? @ingrid?
ingrid: Yup I can review console. But console e2e will fail until SDK is merged or we point it at a preview SDK build. We should avoid merging console before SDK to keep main green.
camille: Proposed order: 1) merge API PR, 2) merge SDK PR (with short-lived compat removed / toggled off), 3) merge console, 4) bump charts. But if API merge causes prod fallout we should canary the API change and have SDK point at canary. Thoughts?
ryan: That sounds right. One operational note: chart bump needs new SDK image tag which comes from the SDK pipeline after merge. We can do a follow-up chart PR that references the SDK release.
pranay: Reviewed API — small nit on docs and one test fix, I can push a patch. No blocking design issues. Approving once tests pass.
sofia: On SDK — I see the compat flag. Can we make the default prefer the new field but still support the old for one release? Add a deprecation note in CHANGELOG.md. I'll approve after that.
camille: Good call. I'll update SDK PR with deprecation note and set default to new.
ingrid: For console e2e, I can trigger a preview run if you publish the SDK as a pre-release. Otherwise hold.
camille: I'll request a prerelease from the SDK CI once SDK tests are green.
pranay: Pushed fix to API; CI rerunning. pinging @ryan for ops sign-off on the canary plan?
ryan: Ops OK with canary. Please add a short rollback step in the PR description (kubectl rollback + previous image tag).
camille: Added rollback steps and deploy playbook link.
deploy-bot: Deployment note: `staging` cluster will pick up `redwood-api:canary-2798` once PR merges and image builds.
sofia: SDK tests are green locally; running CI now. If CI passes I'll mark ready-for-merge.
ingrid: Once SDK merged, I'll rebase console PR and run the e2e. If e2e passes I'll merge console.
camille: OK timeline: pranay (api) today, sofia (sdk) today, ingrid (console) tomorrow morning, charts will be follow-up. If anyone needs me to hold off a merge for coordinated deploy window say now.
ryan: No need to hold — just ensure you tag the charts PR for the next maintenance window.
sofia: SDK CI passed — marking approved. @camille you can merge SDK after pranay approves API.
pranay: API CI passed and I approved. Merging now.
camille: Merged API. Logs show canary deploy started.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for redwood-api (image canary-2798) on staging at 2026-03-17T14:12:03Z.
sofia: Merging SDK now.
camille: SDK merged and prerelease created: `redwood-sdk@0.12.3-rc.1`. tagging console to use that.
ingrid: Rebasing console now and running e2e.
ingrid: e2e passed in staging. Merging console. :rocket:
camille: Console merged. Filing charts PR to bump runtime images to new console/service images.
ryan: Great coordination — thanks everyone. Quick follow-ups: add a short note in the cross-repo playbook about this exact ordering (api -> sdk -> console -> charts) and the prerelease step so we don't repeat the ad-hoc process.
camille: Will add a short section to the playbook and link the PRs. Thanks all! :tada:
